theme: Sabbath Camp: God Can Do All Things
summary: Job trusted that God can do all things. He prayed for his friends, and God blessed the rest of his life even more than the beginning. Region 1 is complete!

story_reel.narration: Welcome to Sabbath Camp, and to the end of the Garden of Beginnings! After God spoke from the storm, Job said, 'I know that You can do all things, and no plan of Yours can be stopped.' Job didn't have every answer, but he knew God, and that changed everything. Then God asked Job to pray for his three friends, the ones who had said wrong things. And Job did! He forgave them and prayed for them. After that, God restored Job. He gave him twice as much as he had before, and Job had seven sons and three daughters again. His daughters were the most beautiful in the land. God blessed the last part of Job's life even more than the first. Look how far you've come! You've seen creation, the garden, the first promise, Noah's rainbow, Babel, and Job. Through every story, one thing is true: Yahweh is with us, and He can do all things.
